items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Dave’s distinctive songs have been recorded by Rosemary Clooney...

ctx.x: Dave Frishberg was born on March 23, 1933 in St. Paul, Minnesota. He is a highly regarded pianist, vocalist and songwriter, and has performed with an impressive list of jazz luminaries. Dave’s distinctive songs have been recorded by Rosemary Clooney, Cleo Laine, Mel Torme and on his own solo recordings.
Dave was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 16, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
